decisions.reason: Primary Discussion explicitly names Zhong/Liljenquist2006 as the borrowed empirical procedure and replicated cleansing/helping finding; the complete printed reference matches Washing away your sins and its DOI. This is the already shipped original, not later Lee/Schwarz or Schnall companion studies cited for background.

Whole original-specific Discussion explicitly says both reduced helping and relief of moral emotions replicate Zhong/Liljenquist. The stronger OCD effect is a new-group extension and does not make the original comparison mixed. Primary abstract corroborates the same positive verdict. No new conclusion inferred from isolated p values.

The exact primary introduction explicitly targets Griffin and Neal model reference11, the prior Australian manufacturing/mining empirical study; printed reference11 independently supplies the matching Perceptions of safety at work title, authors and year. Neal/Hart and subsequent applications are separate cited contexts. Contiguous raw two-column passage includes adjacent column text without reconstruction; no extracted words are joined across columns.

The paper includes an original-period reconstruction but expressly also reruns every original result on1998–2015observations, beyond Amihud1963–1997sample. Under new-sample/different-time relationship rule this empirical new-period component makes the record a replication; the old-period numerical reconstruction is separately described rather than treated as the only study.

The author original-specific synthesis affirms later-period cross-sectional illiquidity pricing but explicitly finds only unexpected, not expected, illiquidity related to index returns, contrasting Amihud original both-component result. This named disagreement and agreement support mixed, beyond a mere weaker coefficient. Recovering the old-period numerical result cannot be transferred as an unqualified verdict about the new-period replication; the new illiquidity-measure comparison is a further extension.

The General Discussion explicitly lists reproducing Pennycook2015correlates as the first of three named goals and states overall success of these goals in both studies; the following comparison also calls the associations reasonably robust. Discrimination-versus-response-bias contrasts concern a new explanatory extension, not the original correlates. The broader author verdict governs rather than isolated nonsignificance. This new independently selected quote retains the entire contiguous raw two-column excerpt, including adjacent-column text; it is not a normalized repair or a splice.

The primary project provides a separate new replication dataset and17trait-pair analysis outputs, but no author-level original-versus-replication synthesis or sufficiently labelled complete comparative interpretation across those outcomes. Original effect-size calculations and replication Fisher tests alone do not establish a whole-study mixed verdict without reconstructing and interpreting the comparison ourselves. Retain an actual reporting/interpretation limit from these completed materials, not an author claim that the attempt was uninformative or an inference from the failed transport.

Original-specific Discussion confirms both nationality and self-similarity MOATing comparisons and says their restriction to shared identity matches prior research. The abstract governs with generally-replicate wording; the new stereotype outcome and self-enhancement-versus-protection interpretation are extensions. A marginal omnibus nationality interaction does not override the authors interpretation of the original contrast and whole replication. Same DOI confirms online2007/issue2008 identity, rather than two originals.
